title: How One Free Gift Bankrupted a Famous Philosopher
description:
Learn how the Diderot Effect causes lifestyle inflation through a spiral of matching upgrades. By understanding this psychological bias, you can stop overspending and invest the difference.

Free 7-day Money Reset checklist + calculators: https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/money-reset/

Educational content, not financial advice. Narration and visuals are AI-assisted.
